text:
maya: Quick sync — SEO plan for the benchmark blog + webinar landing. Need a checklist for keywords, schema, internal links, and redirects from the old benchmark posts. Goal: launch Wed + webinar Thurs.

sam: I started a doc with keyword clusters and suggested slugs: https://docs.google.com/drive/benchmark-seo (please comment). Core clusters: 'llm inference costs', 'gpu inference latency', 'inference batching techniques'.

leo: For the blog, can we target a short-tail + long-tail pair per section? e.g., 'llm inference costs' + 'reduce llm inference cost with caching' — helps internal linking.

maya: Yes. Action items: (1) final keyword set, (2) schema markup snippet for the blog + webinar page, (3) internal linking map from /product and /docs, (4) redirect map from legacy benchmark urls. Who owns redirects? @maggie

maggie: I can run the redirect plan but need the exact old->new map. If we use Netlify/Cloudflare pages, I'll push a `_redirects` file or Cloudflare Workers rule. Share mapping before EOD Tue.

jen: For webinar landing we should add `Event` schema + `FAQPage` snippets for the Q/A section. Also add OpenGraph + twitter card meta for better share.

sam: Draft schema (drop-in):
```json
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Article",
  "headline": "Redwood Inference benchmark: cost & latency tradeoffs",
  "author": "Redwood Inference",
  "datePublished": "2026-03-26",
  "mainEntityOfPage": {
    "@type": "WebPage",
    "@id": "https://www.redwoodinference.com/blog/benchmark-inference-costs"
  }
}
```
Sam: We'll also add `speakable` sections for audio snippets later.

leo: Internal linking map idea: link from /docs/serving -> blog benchmark (section on batching), link from /pricing -> benchmark (cost example), and add a banner on /blog index to the webinar. Keep anchor text natural e.g., "benchmark: latency vs cost".

maya: Redirects: here's a little mapping I pulled from analytics — please confirm targets:```
/benchmarks/2024-inference-costs -> /blog/benchmark-inference-costs
/blog/old-latency-test -> /blog/benchmark-inference-latency
/products/bench -> /product/benchmarks
```
Can you confirm 301 vs 302? We want permanent 301s for SEO.

maggie: Confirmed — 301 for all legacy blog pages. I'll stage a Cloudflare Worker rule. Will also add `Link: rel=canonical` on new pages to be explicit.

jen: Suggest adding structured CTA markup on webinar page (`Event` schema with `offers` pointing to registration`) so Google shows registration. Also include `sameAs` company links.

sam: One more on keyword placement: ensure primary keyword in first 100 words, H1, meta description, and H2s for subtopics. Keep density natural. I'll comment inline on the doc.

seo-bot: Reminder: site-map updated at 2026-03-25T15:00Z. Run index request after publish: https://search.google.com/indexing/request (manual).

maya: Thanks. Next steps: Sam finalizes keywords by EOD Tue, Leo final content + internal links by Tue night, Maggie prepares redirect rules and test plan, Jen finalizes schema + OG tags. I'll run final preflight Wed morning and post the publish checklist here. :rocket:

leo: I'll also add 3 canonical internal links from evergreen docs to the benchmark so it picks up link equity.

maggie: Posting estimated deploy window: Wed 09:30-10:30 PT. I'll monitor 500/404 spikes and roll back if anything odd.

jen: I'll schedule the webinar CTA email to go out 1 hour after publish. Please flag me here once live.

maya: Perfect — tagging this thread as the canonical coordination thread. Ping me if blockers. :raised_hands:
